enriched.title: Vocabulário e Gramática: Verbos Irregulares e Termos Técnicos
enriched.summary: A aula aborda vocabulário técnico, verbos irregulares e pronúncia em inglês. Os alunos aprendem palavras como 'subscription' e 'tailored', além de praticar gramática e expressões úteis no dia a dia.

vocabulary.definition: Feeling sad because you are alone.
examples: I felt lonely after moving to a new city.

vocabulary.definition: An arrangement to receive something regularly by paying in advance.
examples: I have a subscription to several video game platforms.

vocabulary.definition: Something that evokes admiration due to its quality or size.
examples: The new building is really impressive.

vocabulary.definition: A medical practice that involves inserting thin needles into the body to relieve pain.
examples: She tried acupuncture to help with her back pain.
The movie was so scary that I couldn't sleep.

vocabulary.definition: At the present time, in contrast with the past.
Made or adapted for a particular purpose or person.
examples: The program offers tailored solutions for businesses.

vocabulary.definition: To take someone or something to a place.
examples: He brought his laptop to the meeting.

vocabulary.definition: From one side to the other of something.
Continuous physical force exerted on or against an object.
examples: The pressure in the pipe is too high.

vocabulary.definition: To convince someone to do something.
examples: I need to persuade our clients to use our products.
The instructions were too complicated to follow.
They are called programmers who do vibe coding.

grammar.explanation: Verbos que não seguem o padrão regular de conjugação no passado e no particípio.
rules: Memorize as formas irregulares de cada verbo.
Use exemplos para praticar o uso correto.
examples: Bring – brought – brought: trazer – trouxe – trazido.
commonMistakes: Confundir brought com outros verbos regulares.
Esquecer de usar a forma correta no passado.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate the sentence: 'I need to persuade our clients to use our products.'
practiceQuestions.answer: Eu preciso persuadir nossos clientes a usar nossos produtos.
practiceQuestions.explanation: A tradução é direta e segue o vocabulário apresentado.

practiceQuestions.question: Conjugate the verb 'bring' in the past tense.
practiceQuestions.explanation: O verbo 'bring' é irregular, e sua forma no passado é 'brought'.

culturalNotes: A assinatura de plataformas de videogame é comum em muitas casas atualmente.
A prática de acupuntura é originária da medicina tradicional chinesa.
studyTips: Pratique os verbos irregulares com flashcards para memorização.
Leia em voz alta para melhorar a pronúncia de palavras novas.
originalExamples: They are called programmers who do vibe coding. (Eles são chamados de programadores que fazem 'vibe coding'.)
I need to persuade our clients to use our products. (Eu preciso persuadir nossos clientes a usar nossos produtos.)
Bring – brought – brought: trazer – trouxe – trazido.

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
